content: The DoIP module will get a diagnostic response message (i.e Do IP_TpTransmit or DoIP_IfTransmit is called with DoIPPduRTxPdu which matches to the DoIPPduRRxPdu that handled the data to the PduR) via the upper layer connection to the PduR, so it has to monitor whether the socket connection the request was received on is still established. If the socket connection has been closed, the response shall be discarded and the DoIP shall return with E_NOT_OK in the return value.
